paths.react: src/core is the domain layer: it must stay free of UI so it can be unit-tested in plain Bun. Put React in src/components or src/app.
paths.react-dom: src/core is the domain layer: no UI. See docs/architecture.md.
paths.#imports: src/core must not touch browser-extension APIs directly. Inject a typed adapter from src/lib instead, so the domain stays testable and the capability is granted explicitly.
paths.@supabase/supabase-js: src/core must not reach the cloud. Auth is a src/lib concern; personal memory never leaves the device. See docs/privacy.md.
paths.@openpanel/web: src/core must not emit telemetry. Analytics is wired in src/lib and must never see personal values. See docs/privacy.md.
paths.ai: Business logic depends on the LLMProvider port, not on a model SDK. Only src/core/llm/ai-sdk.ts may import this. See docs/adr/002-llm-port-over-vercel-ai-sdk.md.
paths.chrome-ai: Business logic depends on the LLMProvider port, not on a model SDK. Wire the model in at composition time. See docs/adr/002-llm-port-over-vercel-ai-sdk.md.

paths.~/lib/supabase: v1 is local-only; auth is dormant and returns with its own ADR. Nothing in src/app or src/components may reach the Supabase client.
paths.@/lib/supabase: v1 is local-only; auth is dormant and returns with its own ADR. Nothing in src/app or src/components may reach the Supabase client.

paths.react: src/core is the domain layer: no UI.
paths.@supabase/supabase-js: src/core must not reach the cloud.

paths.react: Personal memory is domain code, not UI.
paths.#imports: Storage access is injected, not imported, so the local-only guarantee is visible at the wiring site.
paths.@supabase/supabase-js: Personal memory is LOCAL-ONLY and must never be given a network client. See docs/privacy.md.
paths.@openpanel/web: Personal memory must never be given a telemetry client. See docs/privacy.md.
paths.ai: Personal memory must never be given a model client. Retrieval results are passed to the agent by the runtime, under policy.
paths.chrome-ai: Personal memory must never be given a model client.
